THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Order under Section 39 A (1)

The allotment specified in the Order No. 25 of 2015 dated 12.02.2015made under the Proviso (a) to Section 38 of the Land Acquisition Act(Chapter 460) and published in the Gazette ExtraOrdinary No. 1902/48 dated 20.02.2015 is vested absolutely in the State and thepossession of which has been taken for or on behalf of the Stateunder Para (a) of Section 40 of the aforesaid Act. But by the virtue ofpowers vested in me by Sub section (1) of Section 39 (a) (inserted byAct, No. 8 of 1979) of the Land Acquisition Act, I, GayanthaKarunatilleke, Minister of Lands and Parliamentary Reforms dohereby divest only the allotments Nos. 1, 2 and 3 depicted in theAdvanced tracing No. KE/DRN/2010/152 dated 19.11.2010,described in the below schedule.
Gayantha Karunatilleke,Minister of Lands and Parliamentary Reforms.
My Reference No.: LD/05/2010/VE/75.Divisional Secretary’s No.: DER/LAN/ACQUI/A1/06.Ministry of Lands and Parliamentary Reforms,“Mihikatha Medura”,Rajamalwatta Road,Battaramulla.09th April, 2019.
SCHEDULE I

01. Lot No. 1 – Kebellalanda – Extent: About 0.0992 HectareNorth: Lot No. 459 of F.V.P. 621 and Kumburugan Oya; East: LotNo. 459 of F.V.P. 621 and Road; South: Road and Lot No. 1533 ofF.V.P. 621; West: Kumburugan Oya and Lot No. 1533 of F.V.P. 621.

02. Lot No. 2 – Name of the Land - Not mentioned – Extent:About 0.0458 HectareNorth: Lot No. 459 of F.V.P. 621; East: Lot No. 3 of this tracing;South: Road; West: Lot No. 1533 of F.V.P. 621 and Lot No. 1 of thistracing.

03. Lot No. 3 – Kebellalanda – Extent: About 1.0947 HectareNorth: Lot No. 459 and 1533 of F.V.P. 621; East: Lot Nos. 1533,1608, 1609, 1613 and 1614 of F.V.P. 621; South: Lot No. 1614 ofF.V.P. 621 and Road; West: Road.
